features.title: Run a skill in Copilot in PowerPoint
features.summary: A skill is a saved set of instructions that tells Copilot how to do one task your way. You pick a skill from a menu, or type its name with an @ sign, and Copilot follows it.
steps: Open the Copilot pane in PowerPoint.
Select the + menu in the Copilot prompt field.
Pick a skill from the list, or type @ and the skill name in your prompt.
Write what you want and send it.
prompts: @copyedit-this-presentation Check this deck for typos and wording.
Use my skill to tidy the wording on the current slide.
limits: Built-in skills and your own skills both show in the list.
A skill you turn off in Manage skills stops being used automatically and leaves the dropdown.
The page says Copilot may not be included in your subscription or may depend on your organisation's settings.

source.label: Use custom skills with Copilot in PowerPoint (Microsoft Support)

features.title: Add your own skill
features.summary: You can upload a skill file or paste a skill into Copilot in PowerPoint. It is saved to the Skills folder in your OneDrive and is for your use only.
steps: In the Copilot pane, select the + menu, then Choose skills.
Scroll to the end and select Manage skills.
Upload or drag and drop your skill files, or paste your skill into the form and select Add.
If the skill does not show, refresh in Manage skills.
prompts: @my-new-skill Run this on the whole deck.
Which of my skills fits tidying a long bullet list?
limits: Uploaded skills are for personal use only. The page does not describe sharing them with colleagues.
ZIP uploads can hold file types such as md, txt, csv, json, xml, html, svg, py and js.
Image files such as PNG, PDF files and nested ZIP folders are not currently supported.
The page lists PowerPoint for Microsoft 365, PowerPoint for Microsoft 365 for Mac and PowerPoint for iPad.

source.label: Use custom skills with Copilot in PowerPoint (Microsoft Support)

features.title: Write a skill file and manage it in OneDrive
features.summary: A skill is a folder with one text file called SKILL.md inside. You can drop folders into your OneDrive skills folder, then refresh. You can also edit, delete or hide a skill later.
steps: In the Copilot pane, select Settings (the ... in the upper-right corner), then Manage skills.
Select Custom skills, then Create OneDrive folder.
Add a folder for your skill. Inside it, put a SKILL.md file with a name and a description between the triple-dash lines, then your instructions.
Back in the Custom skills dialog, select Refresh.
prompts: @your-skill-name Apply it to the selected slide.
Show me which skills I have turned on.
limits: The folder name must match the name in SKILL.md, or Copilot skips the skill.
The description in SKILL.md must tell Copilot when to use the skill. The instructions below it have no format limits.
To hide a skill without deleting it, rename its folder so it no longer matches the name. In Manage skills you can also select Edit or Delete under a custom skill.
The page links to the Agent Skills specification for standard formatting. It gives no size limit.

source.label: Use custom skills with Copilot in PowerPoint (Microsoft Support)

issues.text: Your own skills are personal. They are saved in your OneDrive and only you can use them. No page I read describes sharing a personal skill in PowerPoint.

source.label: MC1441782 Upload or add a custom skill with Copilot in PowerPoint (Web)

issues.text: Skill files cannot include PNG images, PDF files or nested ZIP folders at the moment.

source.label: Use custom skills with Copilot in PowerPoint (Microsoft Support)

issues.text: Skills made by your IT admins for the whole company (organisation skills) are a separate feature for PowerPoint for Windows. Admins upload them in the Microsoft 365 admin center. Workers cannot create these.

source.label: MC1478961 Organization skill support for Copilot in PowerPoint for Windows

changes.text: Organisation skills for Copilot in PowerPoint for Windows announced as generally available: admins upload skills in the Microsoft 365 admin center and share them across the company.

Skills in Copilot Chat announced as generally available, with rollout from October 2026 to mid-November 2026. Users can create, edit, upload and share skills there; admins manage them under Agents > Tools.
